content.text: Let me query the electric power sensors for each entity directly.
Now let me find the timeseries ids and compute the energy on 2018-07-19.

All three have 24 hourly readings in Watts. Summing hourly power over the day (equivalent proportional to energy) gives Chiller02 by a wide margin (~1.01M Wh vs CHWPump02 ~39.9k and SupplyFan_AHU01 ~84.5k).
